description:
PUBLIC NOTICE
SHERIFF’S SALE
SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
CHANCERY DIVISION,
GLOUCESTER COUNTY
DOCKET NO.: F-000908-25
SHERIFF’S NO.: 25000868
Plaintiff:
FREEDOM MORTGAGE CORPORATION
Vs
Defendant:
JOSEPH ANTHONY RODRIGUEZ, ARLIN MARIERIVERA, UNITED STATES OF AMERICA
By virtue of the above stated Writ of Execution to me directed and delivered, issued out of the above stated Court, will be exposed for sale at Public Venue, on Wednesday, April 15, 2026, to-wit, at 2 o’clock in the afternoon prevailing time, at 1 N. Broad Street, Ceremonial Courtroom 201 in the City of Woodbury, County of Gloucester and State of New Jersey, all the following described real estate, that is to say:
Property being known as: 105 WEST LOIS DRIVE, WILLIAMSTOWN, NJ 08094 and BLOCK: 13501, LOT: 5
MUNICIPALITY: MONROE TOWNSHIP
ZIP: 08094
COUNTY: GLOUCESTER
STATE OF N.J.
DIMENSIONS OF LOT: 70' x 140"
NEAREST CROSS STREET: NORTH MAIN STREET
SUPERIOR INTERESTES (IF ANY): ANY AND ALL EASEMENTS, COVENANTS, RESTRICTIONS AND RESERVATIONS OF RECORD; ANY SET OF FACTS WHICH AN ACCURATE SURVERY AND INSPECTION WOULD DISCLOSE; ALL UNPAID MUNICIPAL TAXES, ASSESSMENTS AND LIENS; ANY UNPAID ASSESSMENT AND ANY OUTSTANDING TAX SALE CERTIFICATE; RIGHTS OF ANY PARTY IN POSSESSION/RIGHTS PROTECTED BY THE NJ ANTI-EVICTION ACT; ALL LOCAL, COUNTY, STATE AND FEDERAL ORDINANCES AND REGULATIONS; ANY CONDOMINIUM ASSOCIATION LIEN GRANTED PRIORTY BY N.J.D.S. 46:8B-21b; ANY OUTSTANDING CONDOMINIUM, PUD OR HOMEOWNER ASSOCATION DUES OR FEES; RIGHTS OF THE UNITED STATES OF AMERICA, IF ANY; THE PROPERTY IS SOLD IN ITS "AS IS" CONDITION; PURCHAER SHALL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR SHERIFF'S COSTS, COMMISSION, DEED RECORDING FEES AND REALTY TRANSFER FEES.
MONROE MUA HOLDS A CLAIM IN THE AMOUNT OF $43.53 FOR SERWER; $26.30 FOR WATER AS OF 06/06/2025.
VACANT AND/OR ABANDONED PROPERTY REGISTRATION FEE EXISTS - PLEASE CONTACT HERA PROPERTY REGISTRY AT 321-234-5303 FOR DETAILS.
PLAINTIFF'S UPSET BID IS $303,631.39 IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF SECTION 12 OF P.L. 1995, c. 244 (C.2A:50-64) AS AMENDED.
THE PROPERTY IS REPORTED TO BE OWNER OCCUPIED.
THE FULL LEGAL DESCRIPTION CAN BE FOUND IN THE OFFICE OF THE CLERK OF GLOUCESTER COUNTY IN MORTGAGE BOOK 16930 PAGE 142.
The Sheriff hereby reserves the right to adjourn the sale without further notice through publication.
The approximate amount of the Judgment sought to be satisfied by said sale is $250,082.42
The purchaser must pay 20% of the purchase price in cash, certified check, cashier’s check, or treasurer’s check, balance to be paid within 30 days.
A deed to be delivered to the purchaser within 30 days from the date of sale, with lawful interest on the balance due, from the 11th day after sale, until the balance is paid.
Any eligible defendant/party interested in purchasing this property through the NJ Community Wealth Preservation Program set forth in NJ A5664 can find more information on our website at https://www.gloucestercountynj.gov/564/Foreclosure-Procedures.
Sales will begin promptly at 2:00pm. Please arrive shortly before this time to check in if you plan on bidding.
SURPLUS MONEY: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any persons claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person’s claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
Seized as the property of the Defendant, and taken in execution at the suit of the Plaintiff, and to be sold by
Carmel M. Morina,
Gloucester County Sheriff
Advertised online at: https://salesweb.civilview.com/Sales/SalesSearch?countyId=19
Date: March 3, 2026
Firm: POWERS KIRN, LLC
Judgement Date: 7/8/2025
